packs.name: Invoice Chaser
packs.tagline: Know who owes you, send the right reminder, and never fake a payment state.
packs.summary: A focused receivables workspace for solo businesses that imports or records invoices, calculates an evidence-based follow-up queue, drafts context-aware reminders, and keeps every send under human control.

audience.primary: Freelancers, consultants, and small service businesses
audience.job: See which invoices need attention and send a professional, accurate follow-up without rebuilding the context every time.

packs.outcome: The owner opens one prioritized queue, verifies the balance and history, approves a reminder, and records the communication without confusing a draft or reply with payment.

implementation.boundary: This pack defines a receivables workflow but does not provide accounting, tax, legal, email-delivery, or payment-processor assurance.

evidence: The shipping SpecPort checker accepts the pack as an actionable, human-owned product spec.
Acceptance criteria distinguish invoice facts, message drafts, delivery evidence, promises, disputes, and confirmed payments.

effort.typical: Two focused iterations for the local workflow, plus integration-specific testing

packs.name: Local Clinic Scribe
packs.tagline: Turn a treatment conversation into a clinician-reviewed note without sending it to a shared AI service.
packs.summary: A Windows-first, local-processing clinical documentation workflow that captures or accepts a transcript, drafts a structured note with source evidence, and requires clinician review before copy, export, or discard.

audience.primary: Independent physiotherapists and small allied-health clinics
audience.job: Reduce after-visit documentation time while keeping clinical judgment, corrections, and final chart entry under the treating clinician's control.

packs.outcome: The clinician receives a source-linked note draft, corrects it in one review screen, and intentionally copies, exports, or discards it without automatic chart submission.

implementation.boundary: This starter pack is not a medical device, diagnostic tool, compliance certification, or proof that microphone, model, and clinic workflow gates pass.

evidence: The shipping SpecPort checker accepts the human-owned clinical documentation contract.
The spec requires source-linked drafting, clinician review, local data handling, explicit retention, and real-clinic pilot evidence.

effort.typical: Several product iterations plus qualified privacy review and supervised clinic pilots

packs.name: Share to Action
packs.tagline: Turn anything shared from your phone into one clear, approved next action.
packs.summary: A local-first mobile inbox that accepts screenshots, messages, links, and receipts, extracts useful facts, proposes bounded actions, and executes only after the user approves the exact change.

audience.primary: People whose actionable information arrives through many mobile apps
audience.job: Turn a shared item into a reminder, calendar event, saved note, task, or draft reply without manually copying every detail.

packs.outcome: The user shares once, verifies the extracted facts, approves one proposed action, and receives an execution receipt they can undo or inspect.

implementation.boundary: This is an accepted starter spec, not a shipped application or proof that platform permissions and local extraction work on a real device.

evidence: The shipping SpecPort checker accepts the required intent, behavior, acceptance, verification, taste, and release sections.
The product contract names explicit approval, privacy, recovery, and ship-authority boundaries.

effort.typical: Two to four focused product iterations plus real-device permission testing

packs.name: SpecPort CLI
packs.tagline: Portable product contracts and exact-tree evidence for AI-assisted software work.
packs.summary: A local-first command-line product for authoring, checking, pulling, covering, remixing, and handing off versioned software specs without giving an agent authority to invent intent or approve shipping.

audience.primary: AI-native maintainers, founders, agencies, and developers
audience.job: Keep product intent and final-tree evidence inspectable while software moves between people, agents, repositories, and releases.

packs.outcome: A maintainer can carry one accepted spec through local implementation and review with explicit provenance, gaps, evidence, and human ship authority.

implementation.boundary: The reference covers the published 0.1.0 CLI. A merge-ready receipt is evidence for review, not permission to deploy or ship.

evidence: The public repository contains the implementation, tests, schemas, skills, and release procedure.
The npm registry publishes @specport/specport version 0.1.0 with the specport executable.

effort.typical: Several focused iterations with release and CLI compatibility review

packs.name: Offline Second Brain
packs.tagline: Capture what mattered, find it by meaning, and see exactly which local source supports the answer.
packs.summary: A private knowledge workspace that stores notes and files locally, extracts source-linked facts and relationships, supports fast retrieval, and answers with citations and uncertainty instead of inventing memories.

audience.primary: Independent builders, researchers, and knowledge-heavy solo operators
audience.job: Capture decisions and reference material once, then retrieve the relevant source and context without searching folders or trusting an uncited summary.

packs.outcome: The user can add local material, recover a decision or connection later, inspect the supporting source, and correct or delete the knowledge without an account.

implementation.boundary: This starter pack defines local capture and source-grounded retrieval, not perfect recall, autonomous life management, or proof that a chosen model keeps data private.

evidence: The shipping SpecPort checker accepts the provenance, citation, correction, deletion, and release contract.
Acceptance separates indexed source text, extracted facts, inferred links, uncited model output, and human-owned decisions.

effort.typical: Two to four focused iterations plus retrieval evaluation on the owner's real corpus

packs.name: Podcast Cleaner
packs.tagline: Edit spoken audio through a transcript while keeping every cut reversible and audible.
packs.summary: A local media workflow that transcribes a podcast, proposes filler and mistake removals, lets an editor approve cuts in context, preserves room tone and timing, and exports a verified edit plus decision list.

audience.primary: Independent podcasters and small production teams
audience.job: Reduce repetitive spoken-word cleanup without giving an automated editor control over meaning, pacing, or the only copy of the recording.

packs.outcome: The editor reviews transcript-linked cut proposals, hears every transition, exports a clean episode, and retains a reversible edit decision list and untouched source.

implementation.boundary: This starter pack does not include a trained transcription model, licensed music, broadcast mastering, or evidence that automatic cuts preserve every speaker's meaning.

evidence: The shipping SpecPort checker accepts the source-preserving audio-editing contract.
Acceptance requires time-aligned proposals, reversible edits, transition listening, source preservation, and real-media export checks.

effort.typical: Two to four focused iterations plus listening review on varied real recordings
